lines.text: The LORD says Shallum son of Josiah, who was exiled, will die in the place where he was exiled.
The LORD pronounces woe on the man who builds his palace by unrighteousness and makes his countrymen serve without pay.
No one will mourn Jehoiakim, who will be buried like a horse and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.
The LORD says He will hand Coniah over to Pharaoh Neco and the Chaldeans and hurl him into another land.
The LORD says to enroll Coniah as childless, and none of his descendants will prosper to sit on David's throne.
